####################################################################################################
Purpose of script: To write the slurm sh files for each model
####################################################################################################

# Set up
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")
source("fun_brms_mod.R")

pathogen <- "hbv"
dose <- if(pathogen %in% c("vzv", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", 
                           "hav", "multi_mmr-vzv", "multi_mmr")) "v1" else "vl"
dirs$outputs <- glue("../outputs/modfit")
```

# Read formulas 
```{r}
l_formula <- readRDS(file = glue("{dirs$outputs}/formula_brms_{pathogen}_l.rds"))
play_fo <- l_formula[[1]]
```

# Read data
```{r}
play_dat <- readRDS(file = glue("{dirs$outputs}/data_brms_{pathogen}_{dose}_s08_kgc_1.rds"))
unique(play_dat$country)

play_dat %>%
  select(starts_with("imm_val_s1"), starts_with("censored"), sex, age, study, country, center, 
         rct_group, vac_conc, reg_6, pi_vac_week_v1, time_v1_v2, time_v2_v3, time_vl_s1) %>%
  summarize(across(everything(), n_distinct))
```

# Run one model
```{r}
play_mod <- brm(
  formula = play_fo,
  data = play_dat, family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  warmup = 1000, iter = 3000, chains = 1,
  init = 0, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95))

plot(play_mod)
conditional_effects(play_mod)
play_mod
stancode(play_mod)
```

# Extra: Loop over quick
```{r}
sapply(c("rota", "vzv", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "hav", "men", "strep", "hib", "polio", "ipv", "opv",
         "dipht", "dtpa", "dtpw", "tetan", "pertu", "hbv"), function(pathogen) {
#sapply(c("multi_men", "multi_pertu", "multi_polio", "multi_ipv", "multi_opv", "multi_strep"), function(pathogen) {
  dirs$outputs <- glue("../outputs/perpathogen/{pathogen}")
  l_formula <- readRDS(file = glue("{dirs$outputs}/formula_brms_{pathogen}_l.rds"))
  dose <- if(pathogen %in% c("vzv", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "hav")) "v1" else "vl"
  play_fo <- l_formula[[glue("bm{dose}_s08_dfkgc3_{pathogen}_cs2i_reg_6_kgc_3")]]
  play_dat <- readRDS(file = glue("{dirs$outputs}/data_brms_{pathogen}_{dose}_s08_kgc_1.rds")) %>%
    summarize(across(all_of(all.vars(play_fo)), n_distinct))
    #summarize(across(all_of(c("vac_conc", "vac_name_v1")), n_distinct))
  return(play_dat)
}, simplify = FALSE) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "pat")
  
pathogen = "hbv"
dirs$outputs <- glue("../outputs/perpathogen/{pathogen}")
dose <- if(pathogen %in% c("vzv", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "hav")) "v1" else "vl"
readRDS(file = glue("{dirs$outputs}/data_brms_{pathogen}_{dose}_s08.rds")) %>%
 distinct(vac_name_v1, vac_conc, vac_conc_n)
```
